personality_one_liner: A structured, clean, and highly functional team management tool leaning into the traditional Red and White TuS Oberhausen club identity without feeling overwhelming.

spacing.rule: Maintain generous iOS-native rhythms. Content should breathe with clear grouping. Safe areas strictly respected.

do's: Use glass on the bottom tab bar when content scrolls behind it.
Use glass on sticky screen headers over lists or schedules.
Use a frosted glass effect on hero cards overlaid on the handball match imagery.
dont's: Never use glass on simple form fields or basic list rows.
Do not overdo glass on dense statistics or spreadsheet screens (use solid surfaceSecondary for legibility).

screens.name: Login (Namensauswahl)
screens.purpose: A frictionless entry point where the user simply taps their name from the roster to log in.

states.empty: No players found, please contact admin.

screens.layout: Use a prominent TuS Oberhausen logo at the top over a hero background. Followed by a clean, vertically scrolling list of players. Large tap targets (min 56pt) for each name. No password required.

screens.name: Termine (Home / Schedule)
screens.purpose: The core operational view displaying upcoming matches and training sessions.

states.empty: Illustration of a handball with text 'Keine anstehenden Termine' (No upcoming events).

screens.layout: Feed of schedule cards. Each card must prominently display Date, Time, Opponent/Type, and two distinct action buttons: 'Zusagen' (Confirm - using brandPrimary or success) and 'Absagen' (Decline - using a muted tertiary style or error if strict). Sticky bottom CTA if there's a global action, but mostly inline actions.

screens.name: Kader (Roster)
screens.purpose: A directory of the team, displaying players, their positions, and jersey numbers.
screens.layout: iOS-style list with 56pt height rows. Left: large jersey number in a brandTertiary circle. Middle: Player name and position. Right: Chevron for details.

screens.name: Statistik & Anwesenheit
screens.purpose: Visual overview of participation rates and a detailed spreadsheet grid for attendance.
screens.layout: Top section: High-level metric cards (e.g., overall attendance %). Bottom section: A horizontal and vertical scrolling matrix (Sheet/Tabelle) comparing players (Y-axis) against events (X-axis). Use alternating row colors (surface and surfaceSecondary) to ensure the grid is easy to read. First column (Names) must stick.

login_hero_background.alt: Abstract red background matching club colors

instructions_to_main_agent: Adhere to the '1 iOS-Native Clean' personality. Use crisp borders, ample whitespace (lg/xl spacing), and clean Plus Jakarta Sans typography.
Implement the 'TuS Oberhausen' branding faithfully using the #DA291C red as the primary anchor. Ensure UI remains in German ('Zusagen', 'Absagen', 'Termine', 'Kader', 'Statistik').
For the Login screen, build a frictionless name selector list. No password fields are required, just tap the name.
The 'Anwesenheitsliste' (Sheet/Tabelle) requires a custom compound ScrollView (horizontal and vertical scrolling) to handle the Player vs. Event matrix.
Include the user's provided logo for TuS Oberhausen locally or as a prop, as they stated they will attach it. Fallback to an elegant text wordmark 'TuS OBERHAUSEN' if the image is missing.
Ensure 'Zusagen' (Confirm) and 'Absagen' (Decline) buttons are highly visible touch targets on the schedule cards, using clear color affordances without violating the brand guidelines.
